$comment: Owning contract: contracts/evidence-packet.schema.json per ROADMAP.md §0.4, Paper IV §6.6, contracts/events.md event 6. Evidence packet — the structured proof bundle; the unit of verification ('no proof, no done', INV-C1). DRAFT 0.1 — built 2026-10-21 on HgX's order; awaiting ratification. Normative on ratification only.

approval_refs.description: References to approval decision packets (intent_id) this packet relies on

artifact_refs.description: Artifact references: each a digest bound to a revision (links to artifact-manifest)

checksum.description: Packet checksum over the canonical serialisation of the packet (excluding this field)

gaps.description: Explicitly listed gaps (INV-E4: omission is a schema violation, never empty-by-default). Use an empty array ONLY when there are genuinely no gaps, with each gap as a plain-language statement

revision.description: Work-item revision the packet attests (must match the artifact revision — INV-E2)

source_observations.description: Live-source observations with freshness stamps (glossary: Freshness, INV-S4)

fresh_until.description: Reading past this is stale (glossary: Stale)

test_results.description: Acceptance test results, each observed (not asserted)

title: EvidencePacket
